requirementExpectations.rationale: Niva built an ingest validator and retry path for a service used by stations, but the source assigns release scheduling and CDN operations to other groups and does not describe maintaining playback services.
The role identifies a Rust segment-structure validator and its test harness.
Site reliability engineers own CDN operations and on-call.
A bounded staging replay records its sample size, repetition count, and median values.
The client set acceptance rules and Niva maintains operator notes, but the evidence does not say she coordinated partner handoffs.
Niva reviewed archive options and recommended a sample conversion; no migration occurred.
The media-rights group sets policy, and Niva has no key-custody responsibility.
